rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must deliver a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the Notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also submit tenant contact information and a copy of the notice to the City through an online portal.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (enforced by Inspectional Services Department). A violation does not halt the eviction process.

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement.

rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
